With it, your monthly statement says what the jobs that would have gone to voicemail were worth, and compares with last month.

Your data

Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

Download: bookings, leads, conversations (CSV, opens in Excel or Sheets), or customers as a CSV for manual handoff. Check your scheduling software’s import requirements before uploading.
